page_title: BEL 0-2 MOR | Belgium v Morocco 27/11/2022, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+5' Abdelhamid Sabiri (Morocco) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
90+2' 0 - 2 Goal! Hakim Ziyech plays a pass to the feet of Zakaria Aboukhlal (Morocco), and he shoots into the top right corner from inside the box. It's 0:2.
90+1' Morocco work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
90+1' Abderrazak Hamdallah (Morocco) produces a promising shot towards the left side of the goal after his wonderful solo run, but Thibaut Courtois thwarts him and the score remains the same.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Kevin De Bruyne (Belgium) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
88' Dries Mertens (Belgium) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Romelu Lukaku, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
87' Axel Witsel (Belgium) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Cesar Arturo Ramos saw the whole situation.
86' Kevin De Bruyne (Belgium) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
84' The ball possession is 66:34.
82' Jan Vertonghen (Belgium) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header just wide of the right post.
82' Dries Mertens (Belgium) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
82' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Leandro Trossard (Belgium). The ball goes out of play and Belgium have been awarded a corner kick.
81' Roberto Martinez prepares a substitution. Thomas Meunier is replaced by Romelu Lukaku (Belgium).
81' Hakim Ziyech (Morocco) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
79' The attendance is 43738.
78' Substitution. Azzedine Ounahi leaves the pitch and is replaced by Jawad El Yamiq (Morocco).
77' Kevin De Bruyne (Belgium) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
77' Dries Mertens (Belgium) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
76' Leandro Trossard (Belgium) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Belgium.
76' A lofted cross from Leandro Trossard (Belgium) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
75' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Leandro Trossard (Belgium) will replace Thorgan Hazard.
75' It will be a substitution. Charles De Ketelaere (Belgium) is ready to enter the pitch as Michy Batshuayi walks off.
73' 0 - 1 Goal! Romain Saiss (Morocco) deflects a shot with his body past the goalkeeper. Here is an example of luck being on your side. 0:1.
73' It seemed like Abdelhamid Sabiri (Morocco) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
73' Walid Regragui has decided to substitute Youssef En Nesyri and he is replaced by Abderrazak Hamdallah (Morocco).
73' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Sofiane Boufal as he is replaced by Zakaria Aboukhlal (Morocco).
72' Thomas Meunier (Belgium) tackles a bit over-zealously and Cesar Arturo Ramos blows for a foul.
71' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 9:8.
69' Azzedine Ounahi (Morocco) moves forward and unleashes a thunderous shot from distance that flies well over the bar.
68' Here is a change. Achraf Hakimi is going off and Walid Regragui gives the last tactical orders to Abdelhamid Sabiri (Morocco).
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Selim Amallah departs the field of play to be replaced by Yahya Attiat-Allal (Morocco).
66' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Michy Batshuayi (Belgium) inside the box.
65' Dries Mertens (Belgium) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the left side of the goal, but Munir thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
65' Kevin De Bruyne (Belgium) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
64' An attempted cross from Sofiane Boufal (Morocco) is cleared.
64' Sofiane Boufal (Morocco) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
63' Michy Batshuayi (Belgium) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.

61' What a poor attempt! Noussair Mazraoui (Morocco) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes yards wide of the left post.
60' We are about to witness a substitution. Dries Mertens (Belgium) is replacing Eden Hazard.
60' Roberto Martinez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Youri Tielemans (Belgium) replacing Amadou Onana.
59' The Belgium players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
57' A brilliant individual effort! Sofiane Boufal (Morocco) tricks his way past challenges into the box and drags his shot narrowly wide of the right post.
54' Thorgan Hazard (Belgium) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
54' Thomas Meunier (Belgium) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
52' Amadou Onana (Belgium) reacts well near the penalty spot to connect with the resulting corner, but fails to direct his header into the back of the net. The ball floats high over the bar.
52' Kevin De Bruyne (Belgium) will deliver the corner kick.
52' Eden Hazard (Belgium) zig-zags his way into the box and fails to direct a shot inside the right post as the goalkeeper pulls off a miraculous stop.
50' Hakim Ziyech (Morocco) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and fires in a shot that heads towards the middle of the goal, but Thibaut Courtois makes a comfortable save.
48' Cesar Arturo Ramos blows his whistle and signals a foul after Thorgan Hazard (Belgium) brought his opponent down.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+4' The goal by Morocco won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
45+3' Wait! Referee Cesar Arturo Ramos has indicated he is going to review the Morocco goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
45+2' Hakim Ziyech (Morocco) scores a goal from the free kick from the edge of the box. The shot heads towards the middle of the goal, but the keeper is unable to stop it.
45+1' Thorgan Hazard (Belgium) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. Morocco have a free kick.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Noussair Mazraoui (Morocco) trips an opposition player and Cesar Arturo Ramos signals a foul.
43' The percentage of ball possession is – 68:32.
41' Thomas Meunier (Belgium) tries to find Michy Batshuayi, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
40' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Michy Batshuayi (Belgium) offside.
39' Kevin De Bruyne (Belgium) takes the free kick and curls the ball just over the crossbar. That was close!
38' Romain Saiss (Morocco) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. There is a free kick near the sideline to Belgium.
38' The foul by Sofyan Amrabat (Morocco) was seen by Cesar Arturo Ramos who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
36' Thorgan Hazard (Belgium) whips in a cross from the corner, but Munir is well positioned and punches the ball away.

36' Kevin De Bruyne (Belgium) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play. Belgium are awarded a corner kick.
35' Achraf Hakimi (Morocco) takes the chance to have an effort at goal from inside the box but misses to the right of the target.
33' Wonderful pass from Thomas Meunier (Belgium) for Michy Batshuayi, but they can't profit from it as Munir comes off his line to collect.
32' Selim Amallah (Morocco) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Cesar Arturo Ramos blows for a foul.
29' Hakim Ziyech (Morocco) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play.
29' Amadou Onana (Belgium) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
29' Amadou Onana (Belgium) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Cesar Arturo Ramos had an easy-decision to make.
28' Selim Amallah (Morocco) fires a shot high over the bar from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
27' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 2:0.
25' Hakim Ziyech (Morocco) is caught offside!
24' Michy Batshuayi (Belgium) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
22' Referee Cesar Arturo Ramos sees the trip by Thomas Meunier (Belgium) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
22' Thorgan Hazard (Belgium) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
21' What a long-range shot by Hakim Ziyech (Morocco). Unfortunately for him, his shot goes just a few inches over the bar.
19' Amadou Onana (Belgium) brings his opponent down. Cesar Arturo Ramos has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
19' A run and shot from the edge of the box by Thomas Meunier (Belgium) causes Munir little worry as it's towards the middle of the goal. Easy save.
17' Amadou Onana (Belgium) leaps like a salmon and powers a header in at goal from the corner, but his close-range effort is poor and goes way over the bar.
17' Thorgan Hazard (Belgium) takes the corner.
16' Kevin De Bruyne (Belgium) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. Belgium earn a corner.
15' Dangerous play by Sofyan Amrabat (Morocco). Cesar Arturo Ramos blows his whistle for a foul.
13' Thorgan Hazard (Belgium) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
13' Thomas Meunier (Belgium) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. Belgium have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
13' Thorgan Hazard (Belgium) takes the corner with a short pass.
12' The free kick is delivered by Kevin De Bruyne (Belgium) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
11' Romain Saiss (Morocco) is penalised for holding. Cesar Arturo Ramos signals a set piece. Belgium are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
10' Belgium players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
7' The corner from Thorgan Hazard (Belgium) is intercepted by the defence.
5' Belgium can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
5' Great save! Michy Batshuayi (Belgium) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom left corner was brilliantly saved by Munir.
5' Noussair Mazraoui (Morocco) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
5' Hakim Ziyech (Morocco) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
2' Nayef Aguerd (Morocco) jumps into a tackle and Cesar Arturo Ramos signals a foul.
1' A pass from Hakim Ziyech (Morocco) is intercepted by Thibaut Courtois and the move breaks down.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Belgium will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Cesar Arturo Ramos.
